effect_entries.effect: Begins charging at the start of the turn, then attacks as normal.  Any Pokémon that makes contact with the user while charging is burned.  The charging is not affected by accuracy, sleep, paralysis, or any other effect that would interfere with a move.
effect_entries.short_effect: Inflicts a burn on any Pokémon that makes contact before the attack.

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Le lanceur fait chauffer son bec avant d’attaquer. S’il subit une attaque directe pendant la montée en température, l’attaquant sera brûlé.
The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the Pokémon while it’s heating up its beak results in a burn.
